title: As-built timber retaining walls Type 4 and 5 (Matua, Tauranga)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: NZ Building Code B1 and F5 as cited
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Neighbour applied for the determination about retaining walls at a Matua property; the authority is Tauranga City Council; two chartered engineers and the builder are persons with an interest.
Walls constructed under building consent 300162; Type 4 and Type 5 walls assessed against B1 Structure and F5 Construction and Demolition Hazards (protection of other property).
Expert reports and the draft determination form part of the record (§5–6).
Decision: design and construction of the Type 4 and 5 walls comply with B1; construction to date complies with F5 as it relates to protection of other property (7 March 2022).
Appendix A quotes B1 objective and performance clauses.
